name: plapperbot AI Chatbot
author: prodivo

sections.description:
plapperbot turns your website and PDFs into an AI chatbot in about 60 seconds. It answers questions from your visitors around the clock, only based on your own content. If something is not in your content, it says so honestly and points to your contact details instead of making things up.

This plugin connects your WordPress website with your plapperbot chatbot.

Features

  • Chat bubble on your website, connected by pasting your chat link
  • Display rules: all pages, only selected pages or all except selected ones, content types, desktop or mobile only, left or right, hide for administrators
  • Privacy mode (on by default): nothing is loaded from plapperbot.de until a visitor opens the chat
  • Chat inside a page with the block “plapperbot Chat” or the shortcode [plapperbot height="600"]
  • Status of your chatbot right in WordPress: name, plan, whether it is live, password protection, changed link ending
  • Key figures on the WordPress dashboard: questions, open questions and leads of the last 30 days, message quota of the month
  • Overview of your current plan and the available plans
  • Clears the page cache of common caching plugins (LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP Fastest Cache, Autoptimize, SiteGround Optimizer, Hummingbird and others) after changes, so the chat bubble shows up immediately

About plapperbot

  • Learns from your website and PDFs, no programming needed
  • Answers in the language of the question
  • Your logo, colors and 5 chat designs
  • Collect leads, offer a booking link, see what your visitors ask
  • Data stored in the EU, developed in Germany, data processing agreement included
  • Free plan available, paid plans cancellable monthly

External services

This plugin connects to plapperbot, an external AI chatbot service operated by Prodivo e.K., Haingasse 1b, 61381 Friedrichsdorf, Germany.

  • Chat bubble and inline chat: On the pages where the chat is shown, your visitors’ browsers load the chat script and the chat window from www.plapperbot.de (/widget.js, /embed/…, /api/public/bots/…). In privacy mode this happens only when a visitor opens the chat (clicks the bubble or “Start chat”); before that, the browser does not contact plapperbot.de. When a visitor asks a question, the question and the previous messages of the conversation are sent to plapperbot to generate the answer. The chat does not set cookies; conversations are stored without names or IP addresses.
  • Status and plans in WordPress admin: Only after you have connected a chatbot (by saving its chat link), your WordPress server requests the public data of your chatbot (name, logo, plan, availability) and the current plans and prices from www.plapperbot.de when you open the plugin settings page or the WordPress dashboard. In privacy mode, your WordPress server also reads the colour, button size, name and welcome message of your chatbot when pages are shown (cached for 5 minutes) to display the chat bubble. No data about your website or its visitors is sent with these requests. Before a chatbot is connected, the plugin does not contact plapperbot.
  • Key figures (optional): If you enter a plugin key, your WordPress server sends this key to www.plapperbot.de to read the number of questions, open questions and leads of the last 30 days.

Terms of service: https://www.plapperbot.de/agb
Privacy policy: https://www.plapperbot.de/datenschutz
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via Plugins → Add New (or upload the ZIP file) and activate it.
  2. Create your chatbot for free on plapperbot.de if you do not have one yet.
  3. In your plapperbot account, go to Embed → WordPress and copy the chat link.
  4. In WordPress, open the menu item “plapperbot”, paste the chat link and save.
  5. Optional: create the plugin key in the same place and paste it as well to see key figures in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Do I need a plapperbot account?

Yes. The chatbot itself runs on plapperbot.de. You can create it for free and without a credit card.

The chat bubble does not appear. What can I do?

Open the plapperbot settings page in WordPress. It shows whether your chatbot is live and warns you if it is paused, password protected or if the link has changed. If you use a caching plugin, saving the settings clears the page cache automatically.

Can I show the chat inside a page instead of as a bubble?

Yes. Use the block “plapperbot Chat” or the shortcode [plapperbot height="600"]. On pages with the inline chat the bubble is hidden automatically.

What does the privacy mode do?

With “Privacy mode” (in the display rules, on by default) your website shows the chat bubble itself, and the inline chat as a preview with a “Start chat” button. Your visitors’ browsers contact plapperbot.de only when they open the chat. Colour, button size and the welcome message are read by your WordPress server and cached. Opening the chat for the first time takes a moment longer. If you switch it off, the chat script is loaded from plapperbot.de on every page, which makes the first opening faster.

Does the chat set cookies?

The chat bubble and the chat window do not set cookies. Conversations are stored without names or IP addresses and deleted automatically after 90 days.

Is my plugin key secret?

The plugin key can only read key figures of your chatbot and cannot change anything. Still, keep it to yourself. You can create a new key in your plapperbot account at any time; the old one stops working.
